mission_04: The Transformer architecture, originally designed for natural language processing, has proven remarkably effective for time series forecasting due to its ability to capture complex temporal dependencies through self-attention. Unlike RNNs and LSTMs that process sequences step by step, Transformers compute attention scores between all pairs of positions simultaneously, enabling parallel computation and direct modeling of long-range relationships. The scaled dot-product attention mechanism computes similarity scores between query and key vectors, normalizes them with softmax to produce attention weights, and uses these weights to compute a weighted sum of value vectors. Multi-head attention extends this by running multiple attention computations in parallel with different learned projections, allowing the model to attend to information from different representation subspaces. In this mission, you will implement positional encoding, scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, and a complete transformer-based forecasting pipeline.
